neighbours.label: something a person keeps up as a habit over time ('the routine he has kept', 'I've kept a journal', 'maintain this regime')
fire: She follows the same schedule she has kept since college.
I have kept a small diary for most of my life.
Keep up this exercise regime for a few months, then check.
He never strays from the morning ritual he has followed for years.
We have kept a weekly budget for nearly a decade.
My aunt sticks to the diet she has kept for thirty years.
Continue this treatment regime for a few weeks, then stop.
They still observe the habit they have kept since the war.
quiet: She follows the same trail she has walked since noon.
I have bought a small boat for most of my trips.
Hold up this heavy ladder for a few seconds, then drop.
He never strays from the path the guide has marked for us.
We have bought a large table for nearly a hundred dollars.
My aunt sticks to the bridge she has crossed for thirty minutes.
Carry this wooden crate for a few yards, then stop.
They still own the car they have parked behind the barn.

short: a habit kept up over time
